parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: state or imply A/(2a + x) + B/(2a − x) + C/(5a − 2x), before assigning a value to a. M1: use a correct method for one coefficient. A1: obtain one of A = 1, B = 9, C = −16. A1: obtain a second value. A1: obtain the third value. SC: for (Dx + E)/(4a² − x²) + C/(5a − 2x), B0 M1 and C = −16 earns A1, maximum 2/5; for other incorrect partial-fraction forms allow M1 only. [Total: 5]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1 FT: integrate their coefficients and obtain one of ln|2a + x|, −9ln|2a − x|, or 8ln|5a − 2x|; condone missing modulus signs. B1 FT: second correct term. B1 FT: third correct term; maximum 3/5 if a value is assigned to a, with M0 A0. M1: substitute limits correctly into p ln|2a + x| + q ln|2a − x| + r ln|5a − 2x| and remove all a terms, either by collecting like coefficients or like logarithms. A1: 18ln 3 − 8ln 7 from correct working; A0 if logarithms of negative numbers occur. [Total: 5]
